# Legacy image copies — do not edit or reference

The images in this folder are **frozen copies** kept only so that the README and
documentation of past releases (v0.0.4 – v0.3.0) keep rendering. Those versions load
them through absolute URLs to `raw/main/docs/img/...`, which cannot be changed after
the fact.

The images in use live in [`docs/src/assets/`](../src/assets/):

- Edit, replace or add images **there**, not here.
- Do not reference this folder from the README or the docs.
- Do not add new files here.

This folder can be removed once nobody relies on the documentation of those releases
anymore.
